en.title: Wind of Brass and the Memory-Weaving Map
en.premise: I am a traveler who tours various lands aboard a small steamboat, collecting lost tales. One day, in the corner of an old bookstore, I find a record of the "Village Hidden in the Clouds"—a place that should have vanished from the maps entirely. Within that book are the recipes of the dishes loved by the villagers and memories that should have melted into the wind. To unravel this mystery, I take up my brass compass and set out on a journey to find the truth hidden between the gaps in the clouds.

zh.title: 黄铜之风与编织记忆的地图
zh.premise: 我是一名乘坐小型蒸汽船游历各地、搜集失落故事的旅行者。一天，在一家旧书店的角落里，我找到了本该从地图上凭空消失的“云隐村”的记录。那书里记述着村民们所钟爱的料理食谱，以及本应消融在风中的记忆。为了解开这个谜团，我手握黄铜罗盘，踏上了寻找藏于云层缝隙中之真相的旅程。
